mapper.sql: state_hash, provider, redirect_uri, app_state, code_challenge, remember_me, expires_at, account_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mobile_oauth_transaction (state_hash, provider, redirect_uri, app_state, code_challenge, remember_me, expires_at) VALUES (#{stateHash}, #{provider}, #{redirectUri}, #{appState}, #{codeChallenge}, #{rememberMe}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE mobile_oauth_transaction SET callback_claimed_at = #{now} WHERE state_hash = #{stateHash} AND provider = #{provider} AND callback_claimed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > #{now}

UPDATE mobile_oauth_transaction SET code_hash = #{codeHash}, account_id = #{accountId}, code_expires_at = #{expiresAt} WHERE state_hash = #{stateHash} AND callback_claimed_at IS NOT NULL AND code_hash IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM mobile_oauth_transaction WHERE expires_at < #{before} LIMIT 100
